records.title: Single-operator seed rank
records.scope: The full printed statement is now mapped. The actual power-annihilation submodule is proved equal to the ideal primary component. Its inclusion into V/pV has exact kernel pX_p and is onto from the internally discharged Artinian hypothesis. The induced quotient equivalence is residue-field linear. Every intrinsic multiplicity is identified with every actual presentation fibre. The grouped factors are proved to be the literal X_p, and any positive primary decomposition of X_p has the same intrinsic count. The presentation-free maximum over all monic irreducibles is proved bounded and attained, and equals both natural-valued and cardinal-valued seed rank. No caller-supplied decomposition or seed-count conclusion is needed by the public maximum theorem. These are noncomputable mathematical constructions. The printed proof uses a different route through local-module/Nakayama machinery; that separately listed machinery is not thereby marked complete.

The theorem also handles the empty product. Finite products and finite direct sums represent the same finite decomposition. records.title: Cyclic-matrix criterion
records.scope: Block 06 closes the exact six-way criterion for a nonzero finite-dimensional operator over an arbitrary field. The final List.TFAE includes actual cyclicity, canonical seed rank one, cyclicity of every nonzero intrinsic primary component, an actual monic positive-degree one-invariant-factor presentation, minpoly=charpoly, and one-dimensional eigenspaces at every spectral value of the literal tensor extension to AlgebraicClosure k. Minimal-polynomial preservation and cyclicity preservation/descent are proved, not supplied as hypotheses. The one-factor presentation has a constructed basis in which the original operator is the standard companion matrix; its factor is proved to be the minimal polynomial. A separate theorem proves that any actual nonconstant invariant-factor chain has exactly one factor iff the operator is cyclic. This is a mathematical existence and equivalence theorem, not an executable normal-form algorithm or a full sorted invariant-factor construction for arbitrary noncyclic operators. The nonzero-space guard is retained in the six-way statement. Legacy conditional wrappers are preserved unchanged for compatibility, but the new public criterion needs no decomposition, multiplicity, polynomial-preservation, spectral, or seed-number certificates.
